title: Best AI App Builder for Internal Tools & Ops Teams in 2026
summary: We scored eight AI app builders on whether they ship a real backend with server-side auth, survive the builder leaving, and avoid the per-seat cost trap that internal tools usually fall into.
body_markdown: It depends entirely on what's left behind. Remy is built specifically around this problem, treating a plain-language spec as the source of truth so a successor can read exactly what the app does without reverse-engineering a chat log. Blink leaves behind a real codebase in a synced GitHub repo. Retool, Softr, and Bubble all keep the build inside their own visual runtime, which works fine if the successor already knows that specific tool, and creates real friction if they don't.
